title: 酒店入住与需求沟通
description: 前台登记入住、退房寄存、设施询问、客房换房与额外需求表达。

data.chinese: 我用史密斯的名字预订了一间房。
data.english: I have a reservation under the name Smith.
data.soundmark: /aɪ hæv ə ˌrezəˈveɪʃn ˈʌndər ðə neɪm smɪθ/

data.english: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
data.soundmark: /ɪz ˈbrekfəst ɪnˈkluːdɪd ɪn ðə ruːm reɪt/

data.english: What is the password for the Wi-Fi?
data.soundmark: /wɒt ɪz ðə ˈpɑːswɜːd fɔː ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ/

data.chinese: 退房后我们可以把行李寄存在这里吗？
data.english: Can we store our luggage after checkout?
data.soundmark: /kæn wiː stɔːr ˈaʊər ˈlʌɡɪdʒ ˈɑːftər ˈtʃekaʊt/

data.chinese: 请问最晚退房时间是几点？
data.english: What time is checkout tomorrow morning?

data.chinese: 能帮我们多送两条干净浴巾过来吗？
data.english: Could we get two extra clean towels, please?
data.soundmark: /kʊd wiː ɡet tuː ˈekstrə kliːn ˈtaʊəlz pliːz/

data.chinese: 我们房间里的空调好像坏掉了。
data.english: The air conditioner in our room is not working.
data.soundmark: /ðə eə kənˈdɪʃənər ɪn ˈaʊər ruːm ɪz nɒt ˈwɜːkɪŋ/

data.chinese: 请问我们可以换到一个更安静的房间吗？
data.english: Is it possible to switch to a quieter room?
data.soundmark: /ɪz ɪt ˈpɒsəbl tə swɪtʃ tə ə ˈkwaɪətər ruːm/

data.chinese: 明早七点能帮我们安排叫醒电话吗？
data.english: Could I have a wake up call at seven?
data.soundmark: /kʊd aɪ hæv ə weɪk ʌp kɔːl æt ˈsevn/

data.chinese: 我们住得很愉快，非常感谢你们周到的服务。
data.english: We enjoyed our stay very much.
